claim_or_approach: Tidelift 2024 survey: 24% of maintainer income comes from company salaries that explicitly include open source maintenance
support_quote: from company salaries that explicitly include open source maintenance (24 percent)
paraphrase: Per the Tidelift 2024 survey as reported, employer salaries covering maintenance are a 24% share of maintainer income.
requirements_and_tradeoffs: Requires an employer that values the project; only reaches employed maintainers
counterevidence: Vendor-run survey; same article reports direct company payments 5%, foundations 3%
uncertainty: Denominator is share of income, not share of maintainers; ~400 respondents, self-selected; tool summary split the sentence, not seen as one span

claim_or_approach: GitHub Sponsors supports over 70,000 maintainers and organizations; organization sponsorships average ~15x individual ones
support_quote: The program supports over 70,000 maintainers and organizations.
paraphrase: Recipient count allows a crude mean: >$100M over ~7 years across >70,000 recipients is roughly $1,400 lifetime per recipient on average.
counterevidence: GitHub-sourced figures relayed by press; mean hides heavy skew
uncertainty: Recipients include organizations; 'supports' may count profiles, not payees; derived mean is my arithmetic
